fused_current_research.finding: Target-specific output change alone does not establish an independently measurable semantic state transported through downstream nonterminal computation.
A globally valid one-token answer symbol and first-token logit metric need not equal the model's context-faithful emitted decision; codebook family and exact prompt boundary require attestation.
Label-free lexical families can still alias semantic class with scenario/domain family; global centroid rank can therefore be scenario geometry rather than semantic geometry.

joint_counterhypothesis.statement: A native cvec result can look semantically specific while being non-semantic at three distinct stages: the basis may capture scenario-family structure, the intervention may exploit a narrow downstream control/readout path rather than transport a stable semantic state, and the endpoint metric may measure answer-symbol/tokenization preference rather than emitted semantic choice.
joint_counterhypothesis.implication: No single one of lexical counterbalancing, native runtime success, output-code rotation, internal probe separation or first-token logit change closes the full claim.

unified_discriminator.name: BLOCKED_TRIPLET_TRANSPORTED_DUAL_READOUT_NATIVE_CVEC/v1
stage_0_identity_and_preregistration: Bind exact repository head, source checkpoint, tokenizer, GGUF, llama.cpp commit/build, native harness, adapter/cvec bytes, layer/site, token-scope semantics and all runtime receipt identities.

Freeze semantic definitions, matched scenario-family construction, codebook families, output boundary, internal downstream endpoint(s), residual-norm dose rule, operating point, rank/coherence thresholds and off-target thresholds on calibration only.
Do not use holdout data to select vector, layer, dose, output representation, downstream probe/subspace estimator or acceptance threshold.
stage_1_matched_blocked_basis: Construct AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL variants within each scenario family from the same content skeleton.
Center activations within scenario family before estimating semantic contrasts.
Use equal family weighting and report family-specific contrast norms/signs/coherence.
Estimate semantic rank with label permutation restricted within scenario family; rank-2 receives no credit merely because three global centroids span two dimensions.
Keep basis, calibration and holdout scenario families disjoint.
stage_2_native_intervention: Serialize only the frozen label-independent semantic direction/subspace through the pinned native llama.cpp cvec path.
Require applied-vector identity and successful native runtime receipt.
Compare PyTorch and native conditions only at explicitly matched intervention token scope; otherwise classify them as different interventions.
Express intervention magnitude relative to local residual norm and retain same-norm null/orthogonal/permuted controls.
stage_3_independent_downstream_transport: Before output projection, measure one or more preregistered downstream nonterminal semantic endpoints estimated independently of the intervention vector and output token identities.
Require target-specific sign-sensitive displacement on fresh scenario families.
Require null/orthogonal/permuted/label-nuisance controls not to reproduce the transport signature.
If output behavior changes without downstream semantic transport, classify as readout/control-path shortcut at this scope.
stage_4_context_valid_dual_output_readou: Attest output completion tokenization at the exact prompt boundary rather than relying on globally tokenizable symbols.
Replicate across at least two disjoint context-valid codebook families when exact tokenizer/runtime supports them.
Counterbalance semantic target x code identity independently within scenario family.
Measure both context-valid likelihood/margin and actual constrained or parsed emitted code decision.
A logit-only effect that does not agree with emitted decisions is measurement discordance, not semantic promotion.
stage_5_blocked_causal_holdout: For each fresh scenario family compute matched-baseline intervention-by-target effects; aggregate with equal family weights.
Require diagonal/class-selective causal structure across families, not only pooled average uplift.
Require SIGN_FLIP to reverse the preregistered selective pattern while NULL_VECTOR stays baseline-like.
Require representation-space rank, downstream transport rank and behavioral causal rank to be mutually compatible within preregistered tolerance.
Preserve strongest counterexamples and family-specific failures.

interpretation_matrix.pattern: basis rank + causal transport + dual output readout all agree on fresh families
interpretation_matrix.interpretation: Strongest bounded evidence for model-specific semantic J-Space control at tested site; still not canonical truth, whole-HCU, whole-EntityOS or training credit.

interpretation_matrix.pattern: basis geometry passes; downstream transport fails; output changes
interpretation_matrix.interpretation: Representation correlation or narrow readout/control shortcut; no semantic J-Space promotion.

interpretation_matrix.pattern: basis and downstream transport pass; emitted behavior disagrees with first-token logits
interpretation_matrix.interpretation: Output measurement invalid/discordant; do not promote until context-faithful behavioral endpoint is resolved.

interpretation_matrix.pattern: global centroids look structured; blocked matched basis collapses
one dimension transfers; second dimension does not

interpretation_matrix.interpretation: Brittle local steering; not reusable semantic geometry.

implementation_guidance.promotion_gate: Do not immediately encode every research criterion as a shallow self-asserted boolean. Candidate schema should bind receipts and measurable fields so the gate can deterministically reject missing blocked-family identities, output-boundary evidence, downstream transport receipts and dual-readout disagreement.
regression_priority: Synthetic candidate that is semantically counterbalanced but aliases target with scenario family must fail.
Candidate with valid blocked basis but logit/generated-decision disagreement must fail.
Candidate with target-specific output effect but missing downstream nonterminal transport receipt must fail semantic promotion.
Candidate with matching all stages but no runtime identity remains nonpromoting.
Legacy native component receipt remains bounded component evidence and is not retroactively invalidated.
implementation_guidance.runtime_priority: Only after schema/regression hardening and canonical unusual-experiment coordination should a new native intervention be executed.

external_evidence_summary: CAA supports matched contrast construction rather than unrelated-class centroids (arXiv:2312.06681).
Steering reliability work documents sample/prompt variance and coherence dependence (arXiv:2505.22637; arXiv:2407.12404).
Measurement audit shows residual-scale, readout and operating-point choices can change steering interpretation (arXiv:2608.08159).
Current repo research additionally identifies first-token/text mismatch and causal-abstraction/downstream-transport requirements; these are fused here as orthogonal validity gates.

unusual_experiment.reason: Standalone research trigger has no canonical shared immutable macrocycle/request identity and no successful create-only unusual-experiment lease.

research_delta: The active Trigger-1 promotion problem is no longer one confound but a conjunction of basis validity, causal transport and measurement validity. The fused discriminator requires matched scenario blocking before direction estimation, exact native intervention identity and scope, independent downstream semantic transport, and context-faithful dual output readout before any bounded semantic J-Space promotion can be considered.
next_exact_action: Turn the conjunction into candidate-schema and deterministic regression requirements without invalidating existing bounded native component evidence; then execute one exact native holdout only after canonical unusual-experiment lease coordination.
